emotional_tone: Serious, professional, fast, reliable, clean (Linear/Stripe aesthetic)
forbidden_elements: Placeholder images or generic stock lacking context

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: High data density ('Control Room' grid). Optical alignment. Functional breathing room but tight data rows.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-lg (max 8px) for cards, rounded-md for inputs/buttons

components.sidebar: Fixed width w-64, solid background, 1px right border. Clean module list with Phosphor icons.
components.cards: Flat background (#FFFFFF), 1px border (#E2E8F0), no heavy shadow. Content padding p-6.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid #0F172A, rounded-md, crisp. Secondary: Outline, hover:bg-slate-50. Action buttons must be prominent.
components.tables: Dense, crisp lines. border-b only for rows (no side borders). Table headers uppercase, text-xs tracking-wider text-slate-500. Hover state on rows: bg-slate-50.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. 1px border-slate-200, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-slate-900.
components.search: Prominent top search bar with keyboard shortcut hint (Cmd+K).
components.empty_states: Beautiful, crisp empty states. Subtle border-dashed, minimalist illustration or icon, clear 'Add New' CTA.

icons.style: Regular or Light weight, matching text color

motion.philosophy: Snappy, immediate feedback. No long transitions.

media.instructions: Use avatars for employee tables/user profiles. Use the minimalist workspace image selectively as a subtle background for major empty states if needed, heavily faded.

testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Left Sidebar layout with modules: Dashboard, Klijenti, Zaposlenici, Dokumenti, PDV/IOPPD, Finansije, Vault.
Implement the 58 Document Templates section as a highly searchable, filterable grid or list with a 'Generate' action.
The UI must be exclusively in Latin alphabet (Crna Gora) and use EUR currency formatting.
Include an initial login state requiring the master password ('Getuard1994').
Apply 'Control Room' dense UI principles: tables should fit substantial data without excessive scrolling.
Strictly follow the color palette. No purples. Use Slate-900 (Obsidian) for primary CTAs to evoke trust and premium quality.
